mapper.select: SELECT * FROM commerce_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM commerce_order WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM commerce_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commerce_order (user_id, product_id, product_name, quantity, unit_price, total_amount, request_key, status, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice}, #{totalAmount}, #{requestKey}, 'PENDING_PAYMENT', #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE inventory SET available_stock = available_stock - #{quantity}, version = version + 1 WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND available_stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE commerce_order SET status = 'PAID' WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
